title: App shell chrome
lede: The web top bar is a command strip and the sidebar is a grouped destination rail, with account, theme, help, and log out in one footer menu.

stats.n: Settings stays global. Notifications live on the bell.
Opens the existing palette. Placeholder names tags, people, pages.

pairs.title: Top bar and sidebar
pairs.beforeCap: One unlabeled stack of destinations, Notifications duplicated with the bell, identity and theme competing with nav, and a weak Search… (⌘K) field.
pairs.afterCap: Daily work, Team, Library, and Operations are grouped. Settings sits above an account menu. Search is a command field. The bell owns unread count.

sections.heading: After only
sections.note: Collapsed before was captured on Items and after on Settings, so that pair is not claimed as matched. Phone-width web stayed CSS/source smoke; the Cursor browser viewport remained desktop.

shots.title: Account menu
shots.cap: Profile, Help, theme (40px targets), and Log out open to the right of the footer identity so they do not cover Operations.

shots.title: Collapsed rail
shots.cap: Brand mark, grouped icons, overdue badge on Bookings, Settings, and the account avatar. Group labels hide instead of wrapping vertically.

changes.was: Dashboard through Settings sat in one unlabeled list, then Operations. Notifications duplicated the top-bar bell.
changes.now: Daily work is first. Team, Library, and Operations are labeled groups. Settings is a global destination. Notifications are top-bar only.

changes.was: Avatar and name sat above the nav. Theme, Help, and Log out filled the footer as separate controls.
changes.now: A compact Badgers lockup leads. The footer identity opens Profile, Help, theme, and Log out. Collaborators also reach Settings.

changes.h: The top bar is a command strip
changes.was: A short Search… field, a heavy Preview as outline, and a generic Toggle Sidebar name.
changes.now: Search names tags, people, and pages, carries a ⌘K chip, and grows. Preview is ghost. The trigger says Collapse/Expand sidebar or Open/Close navigation.

changes.h: Active and collapsed states are quieter
changes.was: A red left rail on every active item, and collapsed badges hanging into the page.
changes.now: Active is a filled pill. Collapsed rail is 3.5rem with badges on the icon. Red stays on overdue/unread counts.
